description.raw:
'''Active:''' '''Xin Zhao''' unleashes 4 slashes in an arc over the first 0.15 seconds of the cast time, each dealing physical damage to enemies within. After the remaining cast time, he then thrusts his spear in a line in the target direction, dealing physical damage to enemies hit, increased by 0% – 33.3% (based on critical strike chance)[[Category:Debug]], and [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slowing]] them by 50% for 1.5 (+ 0.5 per 100 AP) seconds. ''Wind Becomes Lightning'' deals 50% – 100% (based on level) damage to [[File:Minion icon.png|20px|link=Minion|An icon representing the keyword Minion]] [[:Minion|minions]].

The farthest [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champion]] or large [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monster]] hit within the thrust's area is also marked as ''[[File:Xin Zhao Challenged.png|20xpx|link=Xin Zhao#Challenged|An icon for Xin Zhao's ability Challenged]] [[Xin Zhao#Challenged|Challenged]]'' and is [[File:Reveal icon.png|20px|link=Sight#Standard sight|An icon representing the keyword Standard sight]] [[:Sight#Standard sight|revealed]] for 3 seconds.
description.text:
Active: Xin Zhao unleashes 4 slashes in an arc over the first 0.15 seconds of the cast time, each dealing physical damage to enemies within. After the remaining cast time, he then thrusts his spear in a line in the target direction, dealing physical damage to enemies hit, increased by 0% – 33.3% (based on critical strike chance)Category:Debug, and slowing them by 50% for 1.5 (+ 0.5 per 100 AP) seconds. Wind Becomes Lightning deals 50% – 100% (based on level) damage to minions.
The farthest champion or large monster hit within the thrust's area is also marked as Challenged and is revealed for 3 seconds.

description2.raw: ''Wind Becomes Lightning's'' damage [[File:Heal power icon.svg|20px|link=Healing|An icon representing the keyword Heal]] [[:Healing|heals]] '''Xin Zhao''' for 33.3% of his [[File:Life steal icon.svg|15px|link=Life steal]] life steal.
description2.text: Wind Becomes Lightning's damage heals Xin Zhao for 33.3% of his  life steal.

description3.raw:
''The durations of [[File:Xin Zhao Three Talon Strike.png|20xpx|border|link=Xin Zhao#Three Talon Strike|An icon for Xin Zhao's ability Three Talon Strike]] [[Xin Zhao#Three Talon Strike|Three Talon Strike]] and [[File:Xin Zhao Audacious Charge.png|20xpx|border|link=Xin Zhao#Audacious Charge|An icon for Xin Zhao's ability Audacious Charge]] [[Xin Zhao#Audacious Charge|Audacious Charge's]] '''bonus''' attack speed are delayed relative to Wind Becomes Lightning's cast time.
'''Xin Zhao''' [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|reveals]] himself during the cast if there is an enemy champion nearby''.
description3.text:
The durations of Three Talon Strike and Audacious Charge's bonus attack speed are delayed relative to Wind Becomes Lightning's cast time.
Xin Zhao reveals himself during the cast if there is an enemy champion nearby.

notes.text:
PENDING FOR TEST: The self-reveal has not been fully tested for complete confirmation. Is the ability invisible when hitting minions and there is no enemy champion nearby? Is the tip of the ability enough to reveal him? Whether it can hit a minion or not? Just if he's around the exit of the fog of war, and even if he points towards the inside of the fog of war? [https://youtu.be/GvLedSeuQ0s]
Spell shield will block both the slashes and the thrust.
* If the spell shield blocks the first, or sometimes the second slash, it will block the rest of the ability, including the thrust. If it is activated after the first slash, it will only block up to 2 slashes and will not block the trust.(bug)
This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time.
* The thrust will occur from wherever Xin Zhao is at the end of the cast time.
* The slashes will occur from wherever Xin Zhao is at the time during the first 0.15 seconds.
Wind Becomes Lightning maintains its casting angle direction in relation to Xin Zhao if he moves during the cast time.
* The direction of the slashes will not move during the cast time.
The first strike's hitbox includes a 275 radius 160° cone in front of Xin Zhao and an additional 125 radius around him.
The second strike's hitbox includes the same 125 radius around Xin Zhao, a missile with 1000 range and 80 total width, and a -60 radius area check upon the end of the missile.
* The 125 radius check does not hit champion summoned units.(unexpected)
Because Wind Becomes Lightning uses an older type of 'healing based on life steal' and not applies life steal, Spirit Visage will amplify the life gain twice (+25% life steal and +25% healing), for a total of +56.25%.
Each of Wind Becomes Lightning's slashes are applied in a separate damage instance from each other.
* This causes effects like Bone Plating to be applied twice and Black Cleaver's Carve to be applied multiple times.
